_comment: Mutation testing of the business logic: Stryker plants small bugs in src/core and checks a test fails for each; the build breaks below the 'break' score. It uses the command runner (our normal `vitest run`, mutant switched on by an environment variable) because Stryker's vitest runner does not activate mutants under vitest 5; the command runner also keeps every time-zone test running. Incremental: results are cached in reports/. Run it through `npm run mutation` (changed code plus open survivors, daily in CI) or `npm run mutation:full` (weekly); both write docs/MUTATION-LOG.md (scripts/mutation/run.mjs).
